about: Synthetic items in the shape of GitHub's /search/issues response for repo:elgatosf/streamdeck. Written for the test; no recorded issue text, titles, numbers or authors.

items.title: Stream Deck 7.6.1 crashes when a plugin registers a dial action
items.body: After updating to Stream Deck 7.6.1 on Windows 11 the application crashes every time my plugin registers a dial action. Restarting does not help and the crash happens on every launch.

items.title: Keys go blank after the computer wakes from sleep
items.body:
### Stream Deck version

7.6.1

### Operating system

macOS 15

### What happened

After the computer wakes from sleep every key is blank and the plugin fails to reconnect until the application is restarted.

items.title: Build fails after upgrading the SDK
items.body: Using SDK 7.6.1 the build fails with a type error in the generated manifest. The plugin fails to load in the editor.

items.title: Documentation should state the minimum application version
items.body: The examples require Stream Deck 7.6.1 or later, but the page does not say so and the example fails to load on older installs.

items.title: Stream Deck 7.6.1: add an API to read the dial press duration
items.body: With Stream Deck 7.6.1 there is no way to read how long a dial was pressed. Please add one.

items.title: Stream Deck 7.6.1 beta build crashes on start
items.body: Stream Deck 7.6.1 crashes on start on my machine every time.

items.title: fix: handle Stream Deck 7.6.1 crashes in the logger
items.body: Stream Deck 7.6.1 crashes are now caught by the logger.

items.title: Stream Deck 7.6 freezes when a profile with 300 actions is opened
items.body: Stream Deck 7.6 freezes for about a minute whenever I open a large profile, and the plugin disconnects while it is frozen.

items.title: Property inspector does not open
items.body: The property inspector does not open for my action and nothing is logged. I have not checked which application version this started with.

items.title: Dial turns lag after the update
items.body: After updating to Stream Deck 7.6.1 the dial lags badly on every turn. The same device on a second computer (Stream Deck app 7.6) shows no lag at all.
